title: Biefeld-Brown effect and Townsend Brown

tellings.quote: have been discovered like the Biffield Brown effect, which you know, I'm obsessed with this Townsen Brown character,

plain: The Biefeld-Brown effect, an effect named partly after an inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown in which electrically charged equipment appears to produce a push, is counted by Michels among real discoveries that point beyond ordinary physics. He brings it up himself and says he is obsessed with Brown.
